# MD4C intake (2026-10-28)

**Decision:** the owner's markdown-framework decision of 2026-10-28, option A:
GUI.Forms' rich text is markdown in the stx_rtf2md dialect, parsed for
presentation and editing by MD4C. stx_rtf2md's `MarkdownReader` stays the
normative reader for RTF conversion; `tests/markdown_tests.cpp` cross-checks
the two over stx_rtf2md's dialect corpus.

**OBSERVED source:** MD4C 0.6.0, commit
`7fc1815a5eeba2af7d6120a76202bf59f3b6e6e4`, <https://github.com/mity/md4c>,
MIT. Copied from SwiftEdit's vendored copy (`third_party/md4c`, unmodified,
downloaded 2026-10-01). Git blob SHA-1 of each file, equal to the upstream
tree at the pinned commit (read with the GitHub tree API on 2026-10-28):

| File | Upstream path | Blob SHA-1 |
|---|---|---|
| `LICENSE.md` | `LICENSE.md` | `3baef6a38a10ed88ca55bb149907296ab7ff3462` |
| `md4c.c` | `src/md4c.c` | `e9f87ba8edf41f47fc131458d5d41b2c3142b4e9` |
| `md4c.h` | `src/md4c.h` | `796fd677961872143b29594a0e21fd3d5f6564d8` |

**Build:** an object library, `gui_forms_md4c`, compiled as C11 into
`gui_forms_core`; no new target is exported and `md4c.h` is not installed.
Flags: `MD_FLAG_STRIKETHROUGH | MD_FLAG_NOHTML`. Tables, task lists and the
other extensions stay off, so their source is read as text.

**API and storage review:** `md_parse` takes the source by pointer and a
32-bit size (`MD_SIZE`), so the adapter refuses input past `UINT_MAX` and
past `MarkdownLimits::source_bytes`. Text passed to callbacks points into the
source or at MD4C's static strings (`"\n"`, `" "`, the indentation chunk and
`""` for a NUL), and attribute pieces are valid for the callback only; the
adapter copies what it keeps and maps source pointers with the total pointer
order. MD4C allocates its own working storage with `malloc` and reports
failure as `-1`; the adapter turns that into `limit_exceeded`. Callbacks are
`noexcept` and return nonzero to stop parsing; no exception crosses into C.

**Licence:** MIT. `LICENSE.md` installs as `MD4C-LICENSE.txt` in the SDK and
as `licenses/MD4C.txt` in program packages (`packaging/licenses.json`,
`THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`).
